# n7 - Docs, executability, and the dogfood

The plan review moved lib registration out of this node: `install_sync_test` fails the moment a
`scripts/*` file requires a lib the explicit `core_files` list does not carry, so every node from
n1 to n6 registers its own libs as it writes them (D25). What is left here is what genuinely comes
last.

The three public verbs get their line in the auto skill, and `rewind` deliberately does not. The
CHANGELOG gets one line under Unreleased. No version bump. The installed `scripts/runner` has to be
executable, which the installer's chmod pass over `scripts/*` already does and which nothing
currently asserts for a newly added verb script.

The dogfood needs an authored scratch intent, not a copy of a delivered one: every node of every
delivered intent is already `done`, so a copy has an empty ready set and proves nothing about
dispatch, and it carries no `delivery.lock`, so any `running` write exits 4. The dogfood therefore
builds a multi-node scratch intent from the templates in the job temp directory, arms a lock for
it, and runs `status`, `sweep` and `step` against it.

## n7 failure-mode matrix
| Row | Operation | Failure mode | Test |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 7.1 | Keep `install_sync_test` green with every runner lib registered (D25, meld of blocker 7) | A lib registered nowhere means `scripts/runner` installs and dies on its first `require_relative` | `install_sync_test#test_core_files_match_disk` |
| 7.2 | Make the installed `scripts/runner` executable | The installed copy is not executable and every invocation fails with EACCES | `runner_install_test#test_installed_runner_is_executable` |
| 7.3 | Name the three public verbs in the auto skill | The runner ships and no skill tells anyone it exists | `runner_install_test#test_skill_names_three_public_verbs` |
| 7.4 | Keep `rewind` out of the skill body | A reset verb is published before anything has measured a run | `runner_install_test#test_skill_does_not_name_rewind` |
| 7.5 | Add the CHANGELOG line under Unreleased | The release notes omit the largest change in the batch | `runner_install_test#test_changelog_has_unreleased_runner_line` |
| 7.6 | Leave the version files alone | A version bump rides in on a feature branch and collides with the release intent | `runner_install_test#test_no_version_bump` |
| 7.7 | Run the dogfood against an authored multi-node scratch intent (meld of major 22) | A copy of a delivered intent has an empty ready set and no lock, so the dogfood exercises nothing and reports success | the recorded transcript under `resources/` |
| 7.8 | Arm a lock for the dogfood session before any `running` write | `node-transition` exits 4 on every dispatch and the transcript records only refusals | the recorded transcript under `resources/` |
| 7.9 | Shell no `timeout` anywhere in the dogfood (meld of probe 36) | `timeout` does not exist on this machine and every step that calls it fails with command not found | the recorded transcript under `resources/` |

## Steps
1. Red: the matrix's tests above, committed before any code.
2. Write the skill line and the CHANGELOG line, and assert the installed script's mode.
3. Green, then the whole suite at its baseline.
4. Run the dogfood on an authored scratch intent and record the transcript under `resources/`.
